E5: X03 added +9.2% (interval -4.9% to +19.3%, 15/13 days). Its weekly parts were +24.8, +1.0, -9.2, +13.5, so the result is positive but not significant. E6: X04 added -1.4% (interval -7.8% to +2.7%), so it is null in the current regime. The X01-based reference MAE on days 99-126 was 0.938, below the no-covariate MAEs seen earlier (1.27-1.39). This is indirect support that X01 still helps, though the days differ. Final: X01 plus X03, with X03 included tentatively.

conclusion: Final selection: X01 and X03. X01 is the established covariate: it carried the strong E1 pair skill and helped alone on days 85-112 (E3 +14.7%, interval clear of zero). Its skill declined from E1, so the system may be changing, and its persistence after day 112 is inferred rather than measured. X02 adds nothing given X01 (E4) and is excluded as redundant. Following the prior lesson, I re-screened the previously dismissed X03 and X04 on the newest days 99-126. X04 is null (E6 -1.4%) and is excluded for the current regime. X03 added +9.2% given X01 (E5), with the interval mostly positive, but it is not significant and its weekly skill is mixed. I include X03 tentatively: the expected gain is positive and the downside appears small. Its inclusion is the main unresolved risk, and it should be re-checked on post-126 data.
